# Tesla Stock And The Price Of Its Ambition
July 20th, 2026 · by Trefis Team
TSLA YTD -30.8% SPY YTD +9.8% XLY YTD -2.6%
Analyze TSLA →
_The company is making a colossal bet on its future, and one number reveals the immediate cost to investors._

...

Tesla’s current expectation for 2026 capital expenditures is over $25 billion. To put that figure in perspective, the company’s guidance for the prior year was for CapEx to be slightly below $9 billion. This isn’t just an increase; it’s a step change in the company’s investment posture.

...

A warning in the fundamentals is manageable when you are diversified and dangerous when you are not. TSLA itself has fallen 74% from a peak within the past five years, and a fall like that lands very differently when one position carries too much of your wealth.
